messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — we need to push a small hotfix for 0.9.12 (regression in token accounting). Planning an expedited cutoff in 30m. Patch must be minimal: version bump, changelog line, one small fix. Who can own the cutover?

sam: I can own cherry-picks and the cutover. Will open the patch PR and ping when ready.

julia: I can do a fast review. please tag me on the PR with `review/urgent`. No migrations, no config format changes allowed.

marta: thanks. CI flakiness noted earlier — try to avoid non-deterministic tests. If we have to skip any flaky test, call it out in the PR description.

sam: creating branch now: `release/0.9.12-hotfix` and will cherry-pick commit `abc1234` from main. patch will bump `package.json` to `0.9.12` and add changelog entry.

sam: draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/2145 (WIP). Title: "hotfix: fix token accounting regression (0.9.12)".

julia: seeing the diff — looks minimal. two lines in tokenizer logic + tests. I'll prioritize review once CI passes.

release-bot: build queued: `release/0.9.12-hotfix` -> job `build-and-test` (#9876). Status: queued.

ci-bot: quick note — flaky test `TestCacheEviction` is unstable; if it flakes, please rerun `ci-bot rerun` rather than skipping tests.

sam: CI passed on linux, mac is still running. Assuming green, will request merge and cut the tag. Plan:
- merge to `release/0.9.12-hotfix`
- create tag `v0.9.12` on the merge commit
- push artifacts to staging and run smoke tests
- schedule a 15m monitor window post-cutover

marta: rollback plan: if we see error spike or increased token mismatch logs, revert tag and redeploy previous `v0.9.11`. ops oncall @julia will coordinate.

julia: oncall ack. I can be available for 45m after cutover.

sam: merge done, tag created: `v0.9.12` (sha `d4f5e6`). build & deploy to staging started.

release-bot: deploy to staging started for tag `v0.9.12`. smoke tests running.

ci-bot: smoke tests: all green.

sam: cutting to prod in 10m unless objections. bumping cutoff lock now.

marta: no objections. locking release branch for hotfix-only commits. reminder: no docs-only PRs in this window — put them in main for later.

sam: pushing prod deploy.

release-bot: prod deploy started for `v0.9.12`. rollout strategy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m pauses.

julia: monitoring logs and SLO dashboards. nothing unusual at 10%.

sam: at 100% now.

julia: metrics look stable. no increase in token-mismatch alerts.

marta: thanks everyone. action items:
- sam: update CHANGELOG.md with short entry and link to PR (#2145)
- julia: revert checklist and postmortem stub if we had to rollback
- ops: keep 1hr oncall coverage for next 2 hours

sam: done — changelog updated and release notes added to the PR.

marta: closing cutoff thread. small retrospective later if anything pops. :tada:
__notes: This file is a synthetic Slack thread for a hotfix release coordination. Messages are a single continuous string as required by agents.md.
